name: CASCADE 4 PERSON SAUNA
description: The Cascade is an elegant and well-designed Almost Heaven Sauna. It encompasses all of the best that Almost Heaven has to offer including high-grade clear red cedar lumber, the 9kw stainless-steel virta heater with digital controls, a therapeutic pink salt bar backrest, and a built in floor. This sauna is ideal for four individuals to enjoy comfortably with wide vertical slat benches for sitting or stretching out. This model is taller than our standard sauna. The added height of this sauna not only makes it a lovely focal point in your home, but adds comfort and extra space to move around and stand up if desired.
